name: 终极地狱之轩辕传说
group_note: unrelated to the 'hell' 终极地狱 pair despite title. Status corrected from a stale 'limited' -- no caveat was ever documented in this lib's own README or group_note, and re-testing this pass found none: admin login (fluffos/Mud@2026) works cleanly, '目前权限：(admin)'. Also found and fixed a real bug shared with siblings zhongjidiyu_airuoyoulan/zhongjidiyu_zhijian: clone/user/login.lpc's query_save_file() only guarded against a non-string id (!stringp(id)), not an empty string -- id[0] on "" returns int 0, which sprintf's %c format then rejects ('Incorrect argument to type %c, must be valid UTF8 char'), crashing on the very first automatic query_save_file() call before any id is typed. Fixed by also checking id == "".
